compliance_matrix.requirement: HTTP and RPC spans must use standardized attribute keys (http.method, http.status_code)
Metrics must use snake_case with base unit suffixes (e.g. _seconds, _total, _bytes)
Alert rules must define summary, description, severity, and runbook_url labels

compliance_matrix.standard_name: OWASP ASVS & LLM Top 10 Observability Security
compliance_matrix.requirement: Telemetry pipeline must enforce real-time masking of passwords, JWTs, and prompts
Dashboards must include standardized time filters, component tags, and threshold panels
All verification runs must emit immutable SHA-256 hashed audit records
